fields.label: Agreement Type
fields.options:
Customer Terms of Service
Merchant Partnership Agreement
Creator Marketplace Agreement

fields.label: Type Code
fields.description: Short code used in the autoname (e.g. MERCH-AGR-v2.2).

fields.label: Version
fields.description: e.g. v2.2 — must match the version string printed on the document itself.

fields.label: Is Active
fields.description: Only one Agreement Template per agreement_type may be active at a time — enforced in controller validate().

fields.label: Requires eSign
fields.description: Unchecked for Customer Terms of Service — that tier is accepted by in-app clickwrap only, never routed to an eSign provider.

fields.label: Template File
fields.description: The Markdown source (.md) with {{merge_field}} placeholders (e.g. {{legal_name}}, {{gst_number}}) — merged and rendered to a fresh PDF per signer at signing-request time via utils/agreement_pdf.py. Not a pre-rendered PDF/DOCX.

fields.label: Template File Hash (SHA-256)
fields.description: Computed on save — lets us prove exactly which template text was live for any historical Signed Agreement.

fields.label: eSign Provider
fields.description: clickwrap = no external provider call; the app just records an in-app acceptance event.

fields.label: Leegality Workflow ID (profileId)
fields.description: From the Leegality dashboard: create one Workflow per agreement type, set its notification channel to WhatsApp, signature type to Aadhaar eSign, add this app's webhook URL under Webhook Version v2.5, then paste that Workflow's ID here.

fields.label: e-Stamp Duty Amount (INR)
fields.description: Per the Gujarat Stamp Act, 1958 (as amended 2025) schedule value for this instrument type — confirm with a stamp vendor before setting.
